page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a printer's ornament centred below it. Printed page number at the head. Catchword "DE" at the lower right.

main_text.l: neque scriptis ab Allatio refcripferit, sed in
plane deprehensus est, ἀλαζονείας πολύξοπον τῇ πνιγῇ[?], καὶ τῇ
Σοφίστῃ τῆς κακίας[?]. Habes iam Hottingere, & quicunque alius, qui simi-
lia consensui nostro opponit, rationes ali-
plurimae praeferri possent, si tam imperito-
sent, quae semel, atque iterum lectae ad amus-
sim examinarentur. Quibus lectis cui non
persuasum fuerit, tantam esse Hottingeri in-
scitiam, quanta illorum esse potest, qui
nec ingenij, aut iudicij acumine, nec
commendandi; ἀλλὰ ταῦτα μὲν καὶ πέρα τῆς μάχης[?].

page.notes: The printer's ornament between the text and the catchword is not text and is not transcribed. Greek passages are reproduced from a small scan; the Greek words marked [?] are uncertain. Long s was read as f in several words ("infulfiffime", "perfuasum", "poteft", "amuf fim") and has been written as plain s. The running head is absent. The page number 679 is printed at the head.
